primary_hypothesis.rationale: A composition-derived ultimate-strength prior from an independent multi-principal-element-alloy corpus should reduce the number of steel yield-strength labels required for useful prediction.

controls.rationale: Hardness is mechanically adjacent but less directly paired with yield strength.
Ductility is a same-domain property with a non-universal strength tradeoff.
Thermal transport is unrelated to steel mechanical strength.
Electrocatalytic selectivity is unrelated to steel mechanical strength.

leakage_policy.canonical_formula_overlap: exclude every target composition from every source-model fit before any target fold is evaluated
leakage_policy.target_split_overlap: use the upstream official Matbench test identifiers; a target row is tested exactly once per repeat
leakage_policy.feature_timing: source predictions are generated from composition only; target outcomes, tensile strength, and elongation are not target-model inputs

decision_rule: Call the edge externally useful enough to rescue the n=30 target only if every frozen practical, uncertainty, absolute-utility, fold-direction, learner-robustness, source-quality, leakage, permutation, and sample-equivalence gate passes. Otherwise retain the exact failed gates.
